title: Person Identification Data
description: Physical Person Identification Data (PID) as an SD-JWT VC, following the ARF PID attribute definitions (EWC WP3).

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier of the PID. The identifier follows the pattern `urn:eudi:pid:<domain>:1` of national PID types, with `aptitude` as the domain.

family_name.description: Current last name(s) or surname(s) of the PID user.

given_name.description: Current first name(s), including middle name(s), of the PID user.

birthdate.description: Day, month and year on which the PID user was born.

place_of_birth.description: Place of birth object as per EKYC: at least one of country, region, locality.

country.description: The country where the PID user was born, as an alpha-2 country code as specified in ISO 3166-1.

region.description: The state, province, district or other region where the PID user was born.

locality.description: The municipality, city, town or village where the PID user was born.

nationalities.description: One or more alpha-2 country codes as specified in ISO 3166-1, representing the nationality of the PID user.

address.description: OIDC-style address object: the place where the PID user currently resides or can be contacted.

formatted.description: The full address of the place where the PID user currently resides or can be contacted (street name, house number, city etc.).

country.description: The country where the PID user currently resides, as an alpha-2 country code as specified in ISO 3166-1.

region.description: The state, province or other region where the PID user currently resides.

locality.description: The city or other locality where the PID user currently resides.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the place where the PID user currently resides.

street_address.description: The street name of the place where the PID user currently resides.

house_number.description: The house number of the place where the PID user currently resides.

birth_family_name.description: Last name(s) or surname(s) of the PID user at the time of birth.

birth_given_name.description: First name(s), including middle name(s), of the PID user at the time of birth.

email.description: Electronic mail address of the PID user, in conformance with RFC 5322.

phone_number.description: Mobile telephone number of the PID user, starting with the '+' symbol as the international code prefix and the country code, followed by numbers only (OIDC / E.164 compliant).

picture.description: Facial image of the PID user as a data URL with the base64-encoded portrait in JPEG format.

personal_administrative_number.description: A value assigned to the natural person that is unique among all personal administrative numbers issued by the PID provider. Member States that include this attribute describe their policy for its values in their electronic identification schemes.

sex.description: Sex code: 0 = not known; 1 = male; 2 = female; 3 = other; 4 = inter; 5 = diverse; 6 = open; 9 = not applicable. For values 0, 1, 2 and 9, ISO/IEC 5218 applies.

age_over_18.description: Attests whether the PID user is currently an adult (true) or a minor (false).

age_equal_or_over.description: Attests whether the PID user is at least the given age.

16.description: True if the PID user is at least 16 years old.

18.description: True if the PID user is at least 18 years old.

21.description: True if the PID user is at least 21 years old.

65.description: True if the PID user is at least 65 years old.

age_in_years.description: The current age of the PID user in years.

age_birth_year.description: The year in which the PID user was born.

issuing_authority.description: Name of the administrative authority that issued the person identification data, or the ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code of the respective Member State if there is no separate authority entitled to issue person identification data.

issuing_country.description: Alpha-2 country code, as specified in ISO 3166-1, of the country or territory of the provider of the person identification data.

issuing_jurisdiction.description: Subdivision code as defined in ISO 3166-2:2020 of the issuing country or territory.

date_of_issuance.description: Administrative issuance date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

date_of_expiry.description: Administrative expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

document_number.description: A number for the PID, assigned by the PID provider.

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, as an HTTPS URL that identifies the issuer.

iat.description: Time of issuance as a NumericDate (seconds since the Unix epoch).

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

exp.description: Time at which the attestation expires, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.
